import sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.sas.tools.xl_watch_refresh import main  # function inside script
# Backwards compatibility: xl_watch_refresh defines full script under __main__, so re-invoke via importlib
import importlib
m = importlib.import_module('meta.sas.tools.xl_watch_refresh')
# Run script main
if hasattr(m, '__name__'):
  pass
# Call through by executing the module's __main__ block pattern:
# Since it's structured with if __name__ == '__main__':, emulate by calling functions:
# We'll just re-implement minimal pipeline here:
from meta.sas.tools.xl_watch_refresh import _read_jsonl, detect_offsets, run_refresh, IN_PATH
rows = _read_jsonl(IN_PATH)
counts = detect_offsets(rows)
out = {"offset_counts": counts}
if 6 in counts:
  series_out, gate_out = run_refresh()
  out["series_panel"] = {"baseline_ms": series_out.get("baseline_ms"), "offsets": series_out.get("offsets")}
  out["gate"] = {"post0": gate_out.get("post0"), "advice": gate_out.get("advice")}
import json
print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))
